label: H.R. 9342
title: GPO Modernization Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill revises certain programs and operations of the Government Publishing Office (GPO).
The bill also revises a Library of Congress (LOC) requirement related to the publication of the Constitution Annotated.
Specifically, the bill revises the Federal Depository Library Program (FDLP) through which GPO provides long-term public access to federal publications.
The new requirement applies to the supplement after the Supreme Court term beginning October 2026 and all subsequent editions.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

B000740.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
B000740.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
B000740.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
